description: A utility module for compatibility and type checking within the FastAPI and Pydantic ecosystem, including functions for type introspection, sequence and complex type detection, and Pydantic v1 compatibility.

methods.name: lenient_issubclass
methods.description: Checks if a class is a subclass of another, with leniency for certain generic types.

methods.name: _annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Determines if an annotation type is a sequence type.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation represents a sequence type, considering unions.

methods.name: value_is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a value is a sequence type, excluding strings and bytes.

methods.name: _annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Determines if an annotation type is complex (e.g., BaseModel, Mapping, UploadFile, or sequence).

methods.name: field_annotation_is_complex
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is complex, considering unions and annotated types.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is a scalar, handling Ellipsis.

methods.name: field_annotation_is_scalar_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a field annotation is a scalar sequence type.

methods.name: is_bytes_or_nonable_bytes_annotation
methods.description: Determines if an annotation is bytes or a non-optional bytes annotation.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_or_nonable_uploadfile_annotation
methods.description: Determines if an annotation is UploadFile or a non-optional UploadFile.

methods.name: is_bytes_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: is_uploadfile_sequence_annotation
methods.description: Checks if an annotation is a sequence of UploadFile.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_instance
methods.description: Checks if an object is an instance of a Pydantic v1 BaseModel.

methods.name: is_pydantic_v1_model_class
methods.description: Checks if a class is a subclass of Pydantic v1 BaseModel.

methods.name: annotation_is_pydantic_v1
methods.description: Determines if an annotation type is a Pydantic v1 model or contains such models.
